title: Wright-Patterson as reverse-engineering site for enemy equipment
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Wright-Patterson as reverse-engineering site for enemy equipment, about 1940s at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Wright Pat was the place that the military would take enemy equipment in order to reverse engineer it.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that in the 1940s, Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio was where the US military took captured enemy equipment to reverse engineer it, meaning to take it apart and work out how it was built. He tells it as background for why the base comes up so often in stories about unknown craft: if anything strange were recovered, this is where it would have gone.
